description: This file defines the Scheduler class for SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, and includes methods for managing scheduled jobs, user initialization, job creation, and interval parsing. It also contains functions for rebuilding default schedulers and displaying cron instructions.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Represents a scheduler entity in SuiteCRM, managing scheduled jobs, user context, and interval calculations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Scheduler object and sets the job queue table name.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the scheduler, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: initUser
methods.description: Returns an admin user for running schedulers or false if none found.

methods.name: fireQualified
methods.description: Determines if the scheduler is qualified to run at the current time.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new SchedulersJob based on the scheduler's configuration.

methods.name: checkPendingJobs
methods.description: Checks and submits pending jobs to the queue if they are qualified.

methods.name: deriveDBDateTimes
methods.description: Derives database datetime strings for job scheduling based on job_interval.

methods.name: handleIntervalType
methods.description: Handles different interval types (minutes, hours, days, months, weekdays) for scheduling.

methods.name: setIntervalHumanReadable
methods.description: Converts interval parsed data into a human-readable string.

methods.name: setStandardArraysAttributes
methods.description: Initializes suffix, date, day, and month arrays for interval handling.

methods.name: parseInterval
methods.description: Parses the serialized job_interval string into an array for processing.

methods.name: checkCurl
methods.description: Checks for the presence of cURL library and warns if missing.

methods.name: displayCronInstructions
methods.description: Displays instructions for setting up cron jobs on Windows or Linux.

methods.name: rebuildDefaultSchedulers
methods.description: Deletes existing schedulers and creates default scheduler entries.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Overrides SugarBean method to create export query.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Overrides SugarBean method to fill additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Overrides SugarBean method for additional detail fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view, including interval parsing and human-readable formatting.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the scheduler's name as summary text.

methods.name: getJobsList
methods.description: Returns a list of available job functions for schedulers.
